caption: The drawing shows two ceramic pitchers placed side by side against a plain, beige background. Both pitchers are light tan or cream-colored with blue painted decoration. The pitcher on the left has a wide body, a narrow neck, and a small, slightly flared lip, with a blue floral design on its body and blue detailing on its neck. The pitcher on the right is taller and more slender, with an outwardly flared rim and a curved handle attached to its upper body, a feature missing from the left pitcher. It also features blue leaf-shaped decorations around the upper section and a blue motif at the lower part near the handle. The objects are drawn with subdued colors and delicate shading, providing a sense of volume and depth. There are handwritten notations at the bottom of each pitcher, and “M.A.R.S.” is written along with a small red star near the bottom right of the right pitcher.
title: Stoneware Cream Pitcher
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
